description: This file defines the ConsulGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface to retrieve gateway URIs from Consul-based membership data within Orleans clustering.

classes.name: ConsulGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to fetch gateway addresses from Consul for Orleans clustering.

methods.name: ConsulGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and configuration options.

methods.name: MaxStaleness
methods.description: Property returning the maximum staleness duration for gateway list updates.

methods.name: IsUpdatable
methods.description: Property indicating whether the gateway list provider supports updates.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the Consul client for fetching gateway data.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of active gateway URIs from Consul membership data.
